name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair MacLeod's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his father's garage in the Scottish Highlands. He quickly developed a knack for understanding the intricate workings of vehicles and a passion for pushing them to their limits. Alistair pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and performance optimization. He initially joined Mitsubishi Motorsport as a junior engineer, quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp analytical skills and pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

As Head of Operations, Alistair excels at streamlining processes and ensuring the smooth functioning of the entire team. He is known for his meticulous planning, attention to detail, and ability to remain calm under pressure. Alistair fosters a culture of collaboration and efficiency, always seeking innovative ways to improve performance and reduce costs. He believes in empowering his team members, providing them with the resources and support they need to succeed.

What sets Alistair apart is his unique blend of technical expertise and managerial acumen. He is not afraid to get his hands dirty and can often be found on the shop floor, working alongside his team to troubleshoot issues and implement improvements. He combines a data-driven approach with a strong understanding of the human element, making him a highly effective leader and a valuable asset to Mitsubishi Motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting years spent working on cars.
